data.body:
Analysis complete against origin/main bc838aed2.

Current measure
- `_clarity_score` awards generic points for any H2 heading, >=200 chars, >=500 chars, and any dash bullet, then type-specific bonuses. `clarity_check_compute` separately requires >=1 AC checkbox. The DET P1 copy records the same score as coverage but does not block on it.
- This rewards volume and legacy per-type shape, not the author guide leaf/container contract. A padded ticket can pass with no Approach, grounded Scope, or per-criterion verification.
- The score is duplicated in `_engine_support/gates.py` and `llm/plan_review/det_floor.py`; the latter already lacks the bug branch, so extending two copies invites drift.

Recommended deterministic additions, in priority order
1. Required-section shape keyed on graph altitude, not ticket type. Parse sections once. All plans: nonempty Context/Problem and AC. Leaf: nonempty Approach and Scope. Container: AC plus graph-backed child decomposition. Do not require Testing deterministically because applicability depends on whether behavior is testable. A heading counts only if it has nonblank content before the next H2.
2. Per-AC verification coverage. Parse wrapped checkbox items; each must either start `[operator-attested]` or contain an explicit proving/check clause (`verified by`, `verify with`, `checked by`) with a command, test, CI check, or concrete artifact assertion. Report proved_items / total_items and treat incomplete coverage as advisory until corpus evaluation demonstrates precision.
3. Placeholder-free executable scope. Case-insensitive exact detection of the guide lexicon in Scope/Approach bullets: TBD, figure out, verify whether, check if, depends on investigation, choose an appropriate X. Ignore fenced/code/quoted examples. Any hit should cap or penalize clarity because it explicitly defers a decision.
4. Grounded edit-set. For leaves, require a nonempty Scope plus structured file_impact, rather than the current path-like slash regex. The graph/state-aware scorer can use the canonical file-impact field. Existence and consumer completeness remain G1G2/LLM judgments because new paths are valid.
5. AC text hygiene, reusing P6 at the AC-item level: flag bundled independent outcomes, subjective terms, exact `works correctly`, and unproved hedges (`should`, `probably`, `seems`). Avoid whole-plan vague-word scanning; numeric thresholds or explicit proof clauses should suppress obvious false positives.
6. Testing shape when Testing is declared: require one happy-path marker and one failure/edge/empty/invalid/timeout/boundary marker. If cutover/default/migration language is present, advise a live/end-to-end proving marker. Do not infer Testing applicability deterministically.
7. Nonempty Context/Problem and Approach sections are safe structural signals. Persona/problem quality, mechanism correctness, positive-rationale quality, alternatives, coherence, child coverage, and whether a test truly exercises the change must remain LLM-reviewed.

Scoring recommendation
- Replace raw length and any-bullet points with named applicable checks and return per-check evidence. Derive the compatibility score from satisfied/applicable checks; do not simply add more points to the current seven-point scale, since filler would still compensate for a missing required section.

Documentation conflicts
- Current author/user guides still request Success Criteria for containers/epics, but the heading is inert in tests and active epic 1386 / docs child 44c7 own its collapse into Acceptance Criteria. Do not encode Success Criteria.
- The author guide requires naming a rejected alternative, while authoritative G6 says require positive rationale and explicitly do not require rejected-alternative prose. No open ticket covered that conflict, so bug 828a-7407-9d68-4b82 was created and linked discovered_from this task. Until fixed, clarity should check only nonempty Approach, not rejected-alternative wording.

Evidence: src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md:49-87, src/rebar/_engine_support/gates.py:108-140, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_floor.py:154-233 and P6, docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md:E2/E5/E6/F1/G1G2/G6, tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_criteria_heading_collapse.py:5-13.
